prerequisites: No prerequisites. Competencies taught in the advanced modules (topic-dependent) are recommended.

learning_outcomes.text: have advanced in-depth knowledge and skills in a selected special area of computer science
can report on current research results and deal with research literature

can apply working methods from computer science for the selected special area of computer science (development and application of fundamental solution strategies and their formal description, training of abstraction skills, system development)
are able to apply scientific working methods when independently solving problems and communicate the solution
have acquired competencies preferably from the field of Theoretical Computer Science

assessment_methods.method: Achieve at least 50 percent of points from weekly exercise assignments
Oral presentation of the solution to at least two exercise assignments

assessment_rules: Grading is done with 0 to 15 points according to the examination regulations for the M.Sc. Computer Science degree program. To acquire ECTS, students must achieve at least 50 percent of the points from weekly exercise assignments and orally present the solution to at least two exercise assignments. The examination can be a written or oral exam.
